tests.name: validateIBAN missing input returns NoIBANProvided when no argument is given
validateIBAN missing input returns NoIBANProvided when iban is undefined
validateIBAN missing input returns NoIBANProvided when iban is null
validateIBAN missing input returns NoIBANProvided when iban is an empty string
validateIBAN unknown country returns only NoIBANCountry for an unsupported country code
validateIBAN unknown country treats country codes case-sensitively (lowercase does not match)
validateIBAN wrong BBAN length reports WrongBBANLength together with the resulting format and checksum failures
validateIBAN wrong BBAN format reports WrongBBANFormat (and the forced WrongIBANChecksum) when the BBAN pattern does not match
validateIBAN wrong BBAN format is case-sensitive for alphabetic BBAN segments
validateIBAN checksum digits not numeric reports ChecksumNotNumber (and the forced WrongIBANChecksum) when the check digits are not digits
validateIBAN valid IBANs validates a well-formed Dutch IBAN with no errors
validateIBAN valid IBANs validates a well-formed German IBAN (digits-only BBAN) with no errors
validateIBAN valid IBANs validates a Swiss QR-IBAN as valid when QR-IBANs are allowed by default
validateIBAN valid IBANs validates a Swiss QR-IBAN as valid when QR-IBANs are explicitly allowed
validateIBAN QR-IBAN restriction rejects a Swiss QR-IBAN when QR-IBANs are disallowed
validateIBAN QR-IBAN restriction does not flag a non-QR Swiss IBAN when QR-IBANs are disallowed
